_about: What each building's icon (build menu, Haven pages) shows, for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set buildings. One building or object, seen in three-quarter view from slightly above, described by its looks and by the one thing that tells it apart at 96 px. Haven buildings are low Norse log buildings with turf roofs of short grass, like their models (Tools/LocalSpawn/structures_manifest.json).
beehive: A Nordic straw bee skep: a dome of coiled golden straw rope with a small dark entrance hole near the bottom, standing on a flat grey stone on a short wooden post, a few honey bees around it
campfire: A small burning campfire: a ring of rounded grey field stones around split birch logs with white bark, bright orange flames and glowing embers
alchemy_table: A round black iron cauldron hanging from a tripod of three wooden poles over a ring of stones, green bubbling brew inside, a bundle of dried herbs tied to one pole
workbench: A small Norse log workshop with a turf roof of short grass, its long front open under the eave, a heavy wooden workbench with a vice, a rack of saws and hammers, and a round grindstone at the opening
cottage: A cosy Norse log cottage with a turf roof of short grass, a stone chimney, a plank door under a small porch, a shuttered window glowing with warm light, a stack of firewood against the wall
dock: A short wooden fishing pier on posts over a strip of blue water, a drying rack of fish beside it and a coil of rope and a fishing net on the planks
eldertree: A small ancient tree with a thick gnarled trunk, twisting roots and a round crown of deep green leaves with a faint golden glow, growing from a little mound of moss
farmplot: A small square garden bed of dark tilled soil framed with wooden boards, rows of young green turnip leaves and a few stalks of golden barley
iron_anvil: A small Norse smithy of dark logs with a turf roof of short grass and a stone chimney, its front open on a glowing stone forge, with a black iron anvil on a tree stump and a quench barrel at the opening
smelter: A squat round stone smelting furnace of grey field stones and clay, tapering to an open top, glowing orange through a small arched opening at its base, a leather bellows beside it
havenbanner: A tall banner on a wooden pole: a long hanging cloth in deep green and warm gold with a stitched emblem of a tree inside a ring, fluttering
herbplanter: A long wooden planter box of rough planks full of dark soil, green herbs, small white and purple wildflowers and a sprig of lavender
hut: A small low Norse log hut with a turf roof of short grass, a low plank door and no window, a split-log bench and a wooden bucket beside the door
irontrap: A large open iron leghold trap with jagged forged teeth and a round iron pan in the middle, chained to an iron stake, dark iron with a little rust
kitchen: A Norse open-air kitchen hearth: a low stone fireplace under a small turf-roofed shelter on posts, an iron pot hanging over glowing coals, shelves of clay jars and hanging herbs
lanternpost: A tall wooden post with a crossarm, an iron lantern with glass panes hanging from it glowing with warm yellow light
loom: A small Norse log tailor's shop with a turf roof of short grass, an open porch with an upright wooden weaving loom hung with stone weights, and lengths of red, blue and ochre cloth drying on a line
palisade: A short section of palisade wall: a row of tall sharpened wooden stakes lashed together with rope, the pale points cut fresh
purificationaltar: A low altar of a flat grey stone slab on two standing stones, carved with glowing pale blue runes, a shallow stone bowl on top holding a softly glowing white light
sauna: A small Norse log sauna with a turf roof of short grass and a stubby stone chimney puffing a little white steam, a low plank door, a bench with a wooden bucket and a bundle of leafy birch twigs
sawbench: A small Norse log woodcutter's lodge with a turf roof of short grass, an open front sheltering a long sawbench with a big frame saw, a tall stack of round logs and a chopping block with an axe in it
skigard_gate: A rustic Norwegian skigard gate: a gate of thin spruce poles all leaning at 45 degrees side by side like diagonal slashes, in a frame between two pairs of upright posts bound with willow withies, standing half open
skigard: A short section of traditional Norwegian roundpole fence (skigard): many thin split spruce poles all leaning at 45 degrees side by side like a row of diagonal slashes, held between pairs of upright posts bound with willow withies
smallchest: A sturdy old Norse wooden chest, closed, weathered oak planks with three black iron straps and round rivets, an iron hasp with a ring lock on the front
spiketrap: A shallow square pit trap of sharpened wooden stakes pointing up, half hidden under a thin cover of leaves and twigs
stonewall: A short section of dry stone wall: rough grey stones laid in courses without mortar, chest high, a little moss in the cracks
storageshed: A small Norse storehouse of dark logs with a turf roof of short grass, raised on short stone legs, a plank door with an iron lock, barrels and sacks stacked beside it
tanningrack: A small Norse log hunter's lodge with a turf roof of short grass, a pair of antlers above the plank door, a brown animal hide stretched on a wooden frame beside it and a bow hanging on the wall
torch: A wooden post with an iron cage at the top holding a burning torch, bright orange flame
tradingpost: A small Norse log trading post with a turf roof of short grass, an open front with a plank counter under a red and cream striped awning, crates, barrels, bulging sacks and a hanging balance scale
wainwrights_yard: A wainwright's workyard: a half-built wooden cart with one spoked wheel on, a spare spoked wheel leaning against it, wooden trestles and a few planks, under a small turf-roofed shelter on posts
wardtotem: A tall standing stone carved with Norse runes glowing pale icy blue, a little frost around its base, cold mist curling around it
watchpost: A tall wooden watch platform on four stilts with a ladder, a fire basket of glowing flames burning on top under a small pointed roof
well: A round village well of grey field stones with a small pitched wooden roof on two posts, a winch with rope and a wooden bucket
stable: A low Norse log stable with a turf roof of short grass and an open front, a split-rail fence before it and a brown horse's head looking out over a stall door
log_bench: A simple Nordic log bench: one thick pine log sawn flat on top, resting on two short round stumps, bark on its sides
plank_bench: A Nordic wooden bench of weathered grey planks with a slanted plank backrest, on four sturdy square legs
trestle_table: A rough wooden trestle table of planks on crossed legs, a round wooden stool on each long side, a wooden bowl and a tankard on top
woodpile: A neat stack of split firewood billets, cut ends facing out, between two upright posts under a little roof of three bark slabs
barrels_and_crates: Two oak barrels with dark iron hoops beside a stack of wooden crates, a linen sack slumped against them
carved_post: A tall Norse guardian post of dark wood carved with a stern bearded face near the top, red ochre paint in the carving, standing on a few stones
flower_bed: A round bed of dark soil ringed with grey field stones, full of blue, yellow and white wildflowers and green herbs
signpost: A Nordic wooden signpost: a tall post with three plank arrows pointing different ways, their tips painted red, ochre and blue, stones round its foot
rune_stone: An upright grey Norse rune stone, a carved serpent band painted red winding round its face with runes along it
hay_bales: Three golden hay bales tied with cord on a mat of spilt hay, an old wooden cart wheel leaning against them
dirt_path: A short stretch of packed brown earth footpath winding through green grass, two worn wheel ruts and tufts of grass along its edges, seen from above at an angle
stone_path: A short stretch of grey flagstone path, irregular flat stones bedded in dark earth with grass between the joints, its edges ragged with grass, seen from above at an angle
hedge: A short, neatly clipped green hedge of small dense leaves, a low leafy wall with woody stems showing at its foot, standing on grass
dry_stone_wall: A low dry-stone wall of flat grey field stones stacked in courses without mortar, a row of stones set on edge along its top, on grass
bellows: A large blacksmith's leather bellows on a low wooden trestle: two wedge-shaped plank boards with dark brown leather pleated between them and a black iron nozzle
quench_tub: A broad, low wooden tub banded with black iron hoops, full of dark water, a pair of black iron tongs leaning on its rim
tool_rack: An upright wooden rack of planks between two posts, blacksmith's hammers and iron tongs hanging from pegs on it
chopping_block: A broad round tree-stump chopping block with an axe bitten into its scarred top, pale wood chips scattered round it on the ground
log_rack: A rack of round logs stacked lengthwise in three rows between two pairs of wooden posts, the cut log ends pale
sawhorse: A wooden sawhorse with crossed legs, a round log lying across it and a wooden bow saw leaning against one end
smoke_rack: A rack of wooden poles over a small smouldering fire pit ringed with grey stones, split fish and strips of dried meat hanging from the crossbars, a wisp of smoke
larder: A small wooden store box on four stone feet with a sloping plank lid and a little plank door, a clay crock and a tied linen sack beside it
herb_garden: A raised garden bed of weathered planks full of dark soil and rows of leafy green kitchen herbs with a few small white flowers
notice_board: A small timber notice board on two wooden posts under a little shingle roof, paper notes pinned to its planks, a few curling at the corners
